crossCutting.title: tenantd exposes exactly the approved RPC inventory
tenantd health and readiness probes are available
records one complete audit event for each mutation operation
does not audit reads, rejections, retries, or no-op mutations
exports correlated and redacted traces, metrics, and logs
telemetry outage is bounded and does not change domain results
readiness and RPCs fail closed when a mapped table is missing
readiness rejects an ahead or locked migration ledger
SQLite contains only migration metadata and tenantd domain tables
persists Tenant state across a production-process restart
one concurrent update wins each expected Tenant revision
Tenant deletion cannot race Workspace creation past parent fencing
Tenant deletion cannot race Workspace reactivation past parent fencing
workload reads apply Tenant and Workspace invocation fences
tenant capabilities use exact operations and resource paths
workspace capabilities cover collection and exact targets
a virtual principal and attached account must both be authorized
virtual-principal mutations audit both identities
a current known invocation key remains usable during identityd outage
an unknown invocation key refreshes through identityd
